correctness.rationale: For a selected bipartite X⊆A,Y⊆B, degree of a chosen vertex is |opposite selected| minus at most one deleted matching mate. Mixed dissociation sets must have |X|,|Y|≤2. The (1,1),(2,1),(1,2),(2,2) exact possibilities contribute ab,t(a+b−2),binom(t,2), with all one-sided subsets counted by binomials. Inclusion maximality: each complete part maximal, (1,1) iff both endpoints unmatched, (2,1)/(1,2) iff second selected vertex unmatched, and (2,2) always maximal. These disjoint classifications yield D and M. For t=a=b=n, M=2z^n+binom(n,2)z⁴. Independent exhaustive 41 parameter profiles 3≤a,b≤5 confirmed all subset and maximal counters; infinite proof is structural.
